items.quote: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
items.claim: The LORD communicated with Moses from the tabernacle of the congregation

items.quote: If any man of you bring an offering unto the LORD, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.
items.claim: Offerings to the LORD should be of cattle from the herd or flock
items.object: offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock
